layman_headline: The market just ripped 20-50% across the board — time to protect gains, not chase.
layman_explanation: Crypto just had a massive rally week, with Bitcoin surging 22% to nearly $77K and most altcoins up 25-60%. Our Solana position is up 6.8% and approaching its profit target of $100. Our XRP position is underwater at -4.5% despite XRP rallying 48% this week — we likely entered near a local top. Everything looks overextended right now, and there's no clean new entry that isn't already stretched.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. SOL is working — let it run toward the $100 target. Watch XRP closely; it's still above its stop-loss at $1.30 but needs to reclaim $1.56 to get back to breakeven. Don't add new positions into this euphoria.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate is deeply extended on 7-day timeframes: XRP +48%, TRUMP +92%, HYPE +39%, ZEC +63%. While TRUMP and XRP show low RSIs (29.6 and 31.6), these readings are paradoxical given massive weekly gains — suggesting the RSI is measuring a pullback within a parabolic move, not a true oversold condition. The Fear & Greed index jumped from a weekly average of 51 to 71, confirming rapid sentiment shift. BTC dominance at 58.8% remains elevated, unfavorable for new altcoin entries. The best play is managing existing positions: SOL is 7.3% from its exit target and showing healthy momentum, while XRP needs monitoring given it's underwater from entry despite strong market conditions.

Entire market is extended after 20-50% weekly moves; mean reversion risk is elevated across all candidates

watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance zone — if it hits $100, take profits
XRP holding above $1.40 support — a break below $1.35 warrants tightening the stop
BTC behavior at $77K-$80K — rejection here could trigger a broad market pullback affecting all positions
market_context: Crypto just experienced a powerful squeeze-driven rally with BTC up 22% weekly to $77K, driven by Treasury buyback mechanics. The Fear & Greed index has surged from neutral (51 avg) to Greed (71), and virtually every major asset is extended on weekly timeframes.
context_banner: Post-squeeze euphoria has pushed the entire market into overextended territory — discipline and profit protection matter more than new entries right now.
